svg.desc: Expertise Architecture Landscape Focuses on serving the community as well as providing an unforgettable experience. We live in spaces that should accommodate and serve our needs. A good design is the one responding to the needs of its users while providing them with a rich experience. Outdoor arrangement & design is the heart of many projects allowing for social interactions. Several landscape designs have been achieved by BECT meeting both the aesthetic & functional purposes. Planning & Urban Design Structure Ensures the safety & the endurance of the design. It supports the architecture design to reach the best outcome. Our team is very well acquainted with all structural building types varying in complexity. Focuses on building a solid urban fabric with no futuristic restrictions to development and expansion. BECT’s Urban Planning services span over a wide range of projects including metropolitan & regional developments, master planning and major urban upgrades. Project Management and Supervision Civil Covers a variety of projects including: roads, bridges, buildings, airports, tunnels, dams, irrigation and water & wastewater. Following up between the design team & the site supervision team is crucial in order to attain the optimum time, cost and quality performance. MEP Considered as the services associated with any project to create safe & comfortable environment. It covers the following : HVAC, Plumbing, Lighting, Fire ﬁghting, Fire Alarm, Water Supply, Sanitary, etc. International Associates Artelia is a French leading multi-disciplinary engineering and project management group with signiﬁcant expertise across mobility, water, energy, mixed-use buildings, and industry. With over 7,000 employees operating in more than 40 countries, Artelia delivers complex, high-value projects that drive sustainable development and innovation. The ﬁrm is known for its integrated approach, combining technical excellence with environmental responsibility, and has played a key role in shaping infrastructure, urban development, and industrial landscapes across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. AREP is a French multidisciplinary consultancy and a wholly owned subsidiary of SNCF, the French national rail operator. Renowned for its expertise in architecture, urban planning, mobility, and sustainable design, AREP plays a pivotal role in shaping dynamic, people-centered urban environments. With a focus on transit-oriented development and public space transformation, AREP integrates innovative solutions that connect infrastructure, culture, and everyday life across cities in France and internationally. DOHWA is the largest civil engineering consulting ﬁrm in South Korea, consistently ranked ﬁrst based on annual turnover. With a strong legacy of infrastructure excellence, DOHWA offers comprehensive services across transportation, water resources, environmental engineering, and urban development. The ﬁrm has played a vital role in shaping South Korea’s modern infrastructure and has expanded its footprint globally, delivering large-scale projects in Asia, the Middle East, and Africa with a focus on innovation, sustainability, and technical precision.
